form.label: Setup and Coverage
form.description: Default window: one hour. Diagnostics are recognized service logs, not failed VM extraction. Identity coverage counts VM event candidates only. No input data is dropped.

search.query: `vmware_vision_events` | eval vcenter=coalesce(vcenter,host,"unknown"), parser_status=coalesce(parser_status,"lookup_missing"), parser_format=coalesce(parser_format,"lookup_missing"), record_kind=coalesce(record_kind,"lookup_missing") | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | stats count AS events by parser_status parser_format record_kind

div.p: Send vCenter, ESXi or Aria-forwarded syslog through your existing collector. Assign the VMware Vision sourcetypes and set the vmware_vision_indexes macro. Sample data is never enabled by the app package.
Default search scope: index=vmware. Set the macro vmware_vision_indexes under Settings / Advanced search / Search macros when using other indexes.

Use vmware:vision:vcenter for vCenter event syslog; vmware:vision:aria for Aria-forwarded syslog; vmware:vision:esxi for ESXi; vmware:vision:json for supported JSON event envelopes. Existing data requires the matching automatic lookup stanza on its current sourcetype.
Use a durable syslog receiver and monitored files or HEC for production. Configure source assignment and forwarding through your existing collection process.
lookup_missing means normalization fields were not returned. It is separate from unclassified, where the parser ran but did not recognize the message.

The parser supports vCenter bracketed events, explicit JSON event fields and quoted key/value fields. Unknown ESXi and Aria messages remain searchable. Aria Operations appliance logs alone do not provide all VM lifecycle events.

search.query: `vmware_vision_events` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | stats count max(_time) AS last_seen by host sourcetype | eval age_minutes=round((now()-last_seen)/60,1) | convert ctime(last_seen)
chart sum(events) over parser_status by parser_format
`vmware_vision_events` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ parser_status IN (unmapped,unmapped_event_type) | sort 200 - _time | table _time host sourcetype event_type parser_status _raw
`vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | where match(event_type,"^(Vm|DrsVm)") OR len(vm_key)>0 | stats count by identity_quality

`vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | search vmware_action=reconfigured | eval detail=if(len(change_details)>0,"details supplied","message only") | stats count by detail
stats sum(events) AS count by record_kind
